$note: The house look and timing, read by the pipeline (frame, voice) and, through timeline.json, by every scene (src/scenes/house/kit.tsx). Only keys some code reads are here. A film may override any of them in films/<name>/style/tokens.json; KIT_TOKENS_OVERRIDE=<file> overrides both.

voice.$pace: The speech check fails a line outside 2 to maxWps words/s (looping or truncation). A line just over is slowed toward targetWps by at most maxStretch. 4.3 suits the house voice at tempo 1.1.

paper.$note: The paper ground and its inks. marker is the one accent (the topic list bar).
